title: ICON
bio: 'ICON' is a powerful collaboration between QueenServeantDonked and JinnaWoods. Produced by periyuh, the song reimagines JinnaWoods’ 'True Icon' with an assertive performance and signature energy. It later appears on *The Candidates* and *The Iconic Pop* as part of the shared artistic universe between the two artists.
